identity.title: Sanitized Hermes Failure-Evidence Capture Hardening
identity.objective: Harden only the observability of a failed controlled Hermes research invocation: retain a small, secret-scrubbed, path-scrubbed sanitized stderr TAIL excerpt (<= 4096 UTF-8 bytes) plus usage-file presence in the sanitized receipt while continuing to discard raw stderr, bump the receipt schema additively from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0, and leave every invocation, provider/model, toolset, retry, managed-profile, request, draft, and policy contract and the controller failure precedence exactly unchanged. WP175K does not repair the unknown exit-1 mechanism, activate the runtime, authorize any H1 rerun, or unlock Alpha.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP175K. The in-runner stderr sanitizer, the sanitized invocation-outcome fields, the additive receipt 1.2.0 evidence fields, the controller evidence wiring, their focused tests, the WP175K package records, and narrow current-truth updates are removed. The receipt schema returns to 1.1.0; no invocation, provider/model, toolset, retry, managed config, policy identity, request/draft schema, dependency, workflow, credential, provider, Firecrawl, order, Gate-C, Alpha, or live state exists to unwind.

api_matrix.reason: WP175K adds sanitized failure-evidence fields to the invocation outcome and the receipt without changing any invocation, provider/model, toolset, retry, or validation surface.

items.before: Carried a bounded stderr byte length and truncation flag only; the captured stderr bytes were discarded before the controller could preserve any diagnostic context.
items.after: Adds stderr_sanitization_status, stderr_excerpt, stderr_redaction_applied, and stderr_excerpt_truncated; the backend sanitizes bounded child stderr before constructing the outcome and still stores no raw stderr.
items.compatibility_requirement: New fields default to the empty/no-child shape so existing constructions remain valid; no raw-stderr field is added.

items.before: Receipt schema 1.1.0 exposed no sanitized stderr excerpt and no explicit usage-file presence.
items.after: Receipt schema 1.2.0 adds stderr_captured_byte_len, stderr_sanitization_status, stderr_excerpt, stderr_excerpt_truncated, stderr_redaction_applied, usage_file_present, and usage_file_truncated to the content-addressed identity; raw stderr remains forbidden.
items.compatibility_requirement: Additive schema bump only; request and draft schemas and policy identity are unchanged; failure precedence is unchanged.

semantic_fields.reason: The sanitized excerpt binds a bounded, secret/path-scrubbed diagnostic tail to the failure receipt and never carries raw stderr.

items.required_rule: a bounded (<= 4096 UTF-8 bytes) secret-scrubbed and path-scrubbed tail of the child stderr, or null when empty, blocked-unsafe, or sanitizer-error
items.validation_rule: never contains raw secrets or local filesystem identity; residual secret-like content fails closed to null

identity_derivations.reason: No package-spec identity derivation changes; focused sanitizer, outcome, controller, and receipt tests are the executable oracle.

state_transitions.reason: RUNTIME readiness plus explicit user authority permits only this bounded evidence-capture hardening; merge and any second H1 run remain separately gated.
